title: Planning gives an item that adds an exception to a gate classifier fail-closed probes: the exception shape beside a real trigger of the class it lowers
goal: A planned check of an item that makes bl_authority read past a word (a class-lowering exception) also asserts the class holds when the exception's shape sits beside a real trigger (an action verb on the push, a remote ref, a credential qualifier, each secrets word in each shape), and precheck warns of such an item whose checks hold no such probe (SP-hlt2tdel: BG-3yjqrfkp's check passed while its exceptions read past real pushes, filed as BG-256h2xwg S1 by the review; ST-oc7hsriu's check passed with the doc-name shape unplanted)

run:
import sys, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir()
def w(o): (d/(o['id']+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(o))
w({'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'planned','goal':'g'})
chk = [{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; import bl_authority; sys.exit(1)']}]
w({'id':'BG-aaaaaaa2','kind':'bug','title':'authority exception','status':'draft','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','severity':'S3','rank':0,
   'goal':'bl_authority reads past the word docs in a push command, a class-lowering exception, so a push of a doc name is not operator-only',
   'touches':['_tools/bl_authority.py'],'repro':{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)']},'checks':chk})
w({'id':'BG-bbbbbbb2','kind':'bug','title':'plain','status':'draft','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P3','severity':'S3','rank':0,
   'goal':'A plain fix of a message wording','touches':['_tools/bl_view.py'],'repro':{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)']},
   'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)']}]})
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'precheck','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
warn = lambda i: [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning:') and i in l and 'already exits' not in l]
a, b = warn('BG-aaaaaaa2'), warn('BG-bbbbbbb2')
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and a and not b else 1)
